notes.title: Free Download Notice for 'Dark Traveller'
notes.content: Dear players, since the product was launched, the sales situation has far fallen short of our expectations at the time. Although we have made every effort to create the game and hope to provide users with a better gaming experience, the actual situation is not as we hoped. In this environment, we have decided to provide free user downloads. Players who have experienced the game are welcome to give us positive comments, This also helps us optimize the game and develop the next product. For players who have already purchased our product, we are very sorry. We promise that if you still come to download it when we release our next product, we will give you customized special props as compensation.

notes.title: [Producer Sharing] Prehistoric Ruins Displayed in the Metaspace of Dark Traveler
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=wlMf5EugdcU;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone, today I would like to share with you some settings about the display of human prehistoric civilization in the game "Dark Traveler".

In just a few thousand years, human civilization has left us with many civilizational mysteries and legends, such as the Sumerian civilization that originated in the Mesopotamia and Stonehenge on the Salisbury Plain, all of which demonstrate the glorious civilization of human beings and also left us with more room for reverie.

In the game "Dark Traveler", we integrated some mysterious human prehistoric civilizations into the game, such as the ancient Sumerian tribes and ancient Stonehenge, and displayed them through the setting of metaspace. The display of these prehistoric ruins helps us outline the whole picture of the events spanning thousands of years. Also, we hope to provide you with more puzzle-solving fun.

Meanwhile, we also set up related easter egg plots for some scenes. Based on the mysterious scenes, we designed many mysterious levels and weaved multiple interesting endings. I hope everyone will like it!

notes.title: [Producer's Sharing] AI Design in the Game Dark Traveler
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=q4Ggp0KOIp0;full][/previewyoutube]

With the emergence of AI-ChatGTP, AI has set off another round of heated discussions. Coincidentally, the super-intelligent AI designed in Dark Traveler - S42 also plays an important role in the process of human development in the plot.

From the artificial intelligence bionics we first imagined in Blade Runner and Artificial Intelligence to the recent application of various AI tools in daily work, AI has gradually moved from our sci-fi imagination to reality. Then how will it evolve in the future? We can imagine more from MOSS in The Wandering Earth 2, Sophon in The Three-Body Problem and Matrix in The Matrix. Their development interferes with or even determines the development of human beings to a certain extent, making people always be alert to various problems in the development of science and technology.

Based on our love to physics and science fiction, we added the self-aware super-intelligent S42 to the game as an important setting for players to explore the plot. We hope that the existence of S42 can provide the players more immersion and more fun in exploring the future world. As for how S42 will choose to get along with humans? Savior or Destroyer? Please find out in the game~

notes.title: Dark Traveller Game Art: Lowpoly Style Design Ideas Sharing and Graphics Appre
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43721017/e6b012dd1589c9e535872e7e0bcf6a3133484bb4.jpg[/img]

Hello players, the action puzzle game "Dark Traveller" produced by our "Colorless Time and Space Studio" has already met with you on Steam. After three years of stumbling, it's finally here! In addition to being excited, I especially want to talk to you here and share some of our art design ideas in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43721017/01f90fea81c4d811df6c9081dacfcb68faf4e170.jpg[/img]

"Dark Traveller" is an action puzzle game in the background of science fiction. In such a theme, the game is destined to have a lot of surreal scenes. We hope to make unique graphics to shape a fictional world that matches the background of the game and inspire everyone to explore the fun of puzzle solving.

We designed the game graphics in the Low Poly style, hoping that the abstract expression brought by this retro-futuristic style can bring out more mystery and uncertainty. And vaguer and more fragmented information seems to inadvertently weave a mysterious story, so that everyone can think more and guess, and gradually uncover the truth of the matter.

At the same time, we hope that the irregular multilateral style of Low Poly can give everyone more imagination. Like a dream, most of the empty part is our lost memory. In the artificial world, maybe only the truth can tell us what kind of scenery is about to come afterwards.

notes.title: "Dark Traveler" has been launched on steam
notes.content:
Hello, players and friends! "Dark Traveler" produced by Colorless Space has officially launched on Steam! I hope you will like our well-designed game plots and levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43721017/35ef201cc9089179edd41d751eba9a34cdc7af08.png[/img]

Out of love for sci-fi, we combined our favorite quantum physics theory with game plots and levels during the game development process. Additionally, we added traditional Chinese ancient mechanism design concepts, hoping to bring you more "hardcore" sci-fi games experience!

At the same time, we also thank all the volunteers who gave advice and suggestions during the development of the game (mainly focusing on the difficulty of the game, LOL). The game is officially launched now. Yes! We don't have an EA period. You can buy it now to experience it completely. We will continue to pay attention to your feedback and optimize the game accordingly!

Finally, our game has been launched on Steam, we hope you will support us a lot! (Remember to leave positive reviews if you like it!)
